Roles and access

Three signed-in roles plus a QR route that needs no account. Each one sees the part of the system its job requires.

Manager

Plans and approves

Reviews requests, creates and assigns work orders, manages equipment, stock and preventive plans, and reads the reports.

  • Approve or refuse requests
  • Create and assign work orders
  • Open the reports
  • Manage equipment and stock
  • Configure preventive plans
Technician

Executes

Sees the jobs assigned to them. Works the checklist, logs hours and parts, closes the job and produces the report.

  • See assigned work orders
  • Work sub-tasks and checklists
  • Log hours against the job
  • Log parts consumed
  • Close and generate the PDF
Requester

Reports and follows

Raises a request against a machine and follows what happens to it, without reaching costs or internal planning.

  • Raise a request
  • Follow their own requests
  • Attach photos and descriptions
QR, no account

Anyone standing at the machine

Scanning the equipment QR code opens a request form with the machine already filled in. This is how an operator on a line reports a fault without being set up as a user first.

  • Report a fault on the spot
  • See the machine's identity card
  • No login and no account needed
